page_title: Vidney | Free AI Video & Image Generator: Seedance, Veo & Kling

sources.entry: Vidney - Multi-model AI video and image generator that runs 40+ models, including Kling, Veo, Seedance, Wan, Grok Imagine and Nano Banana, on one credit balance. #freemium

summary.name: Vidney
summary.one_liner: Vidney is a web-based aggregator that runs many AI video and image models (Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan, Flux and others) from one workspace on a single credit balance, with no API keys.
use_cases: Generate ad creative concepts from a prompt
Animate a starting photo into a short video
Create social media images and short clips
Explore campaign visual directions before production
Produce product and lifestyle shots without a photo shoot
summary.what_it_does: Vidney lets you write a prompt or upload a starting image, choose one of the listed video or image models, set options such as duration, resolution and aspect ratio, and generate the result. The page lists 25 video models and 19 image models, including Veo, Kling, Seedance, Wan, Vidu, PixVerse, Grok, Runway, Nano Banana, GPT Image, Seedream, Midjourney and Flux Kontext. It covers text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-image and image-to-image modes. Each generation's credit cost is shown before it runs, and successful outputs can be downloaded from an account library. The page says the site is available in 9 languages.
notable: One credit balance and one login covers all listed video and image models, with no per-provider API keys
Credit cost is shown before each run; options depend on the chosen model
Page states Vidney does not claim ownership of outputs; commercial use follows the underlying model's terms
caveats: Starts with up to 30 free credits; more credits must be purchased via plans on the pricing page
Refunds on purchases are available within 14 days subject to the refund policy
Commercial use is governed by each underlying source model's license and terms
